correctness.rationale: Two independent exact standard-library programs reconstruct the canonical graph, agree on 2,597 faces and mod-two Betti rank ten in dimension four; the main code verifies 1,293 matched pairs and the entire 11,430-cover acyclic directed face poset, giving integral Morse concentration. Exhaustive 216-automorphism enumeration, conjugacy verification and a proved quotient-independence-polynomial Lefschetz formula yield all 13 integer character values; independent direct signed-chain traces on explicit reps confirm each value. Class sums prove the invariant-space and irreducible-multiplicity conclusions.

value.rationale: The Pappus Levi graph is a canonical geometric incidence object with substantial 216-element symmetry. The exact full top-homology character determines 13 class traces, vanishing global invariants and a multiplicity-free two-irrep complex decomposition, information not supplied by its previously known homotopy type or cyclic subgroup trace. Two order-three classes with the same vertex-cycle type have unequal homology traces, exhibiting a meaningful structural distinction and making the exact table a useful equivariant benchmark.
